story.label: CAU CHUYEN
story.body: Vao nam 2117, truoc hau qua su sup do cua Trai Dat, nhung nguoi sot lai da khoi xuong cuoc Hyper Tek Exodus. No luc cuoi cung cua nhan loai de ton tai khong dan den viec chinh phuc cac vi sao; thay vao do, no tan ra khap noi, phan tan AI, bo gen nang cao va cac nguyen mau tren hang nghin the gioi hat giong. Nhung the ky da qua, khi moi the gioi phat trien trong su co lap, lam nay sinh cac loai moi, van hoa va cong nghe moi. O trung tam cua tat ca la Echo Core, mot di vat luong tu dang dap voi nghich ly, ky uc va loi keu goi quyen nang. No thuc tinh ban nhu mot Overlord tai sinh, duoc duc nen tu di san va cong nghe.

about.title: Nam 2117.
about.body: Nhan loai da khong chinh phuc cac vi sao - no vo thanh manh. Sau su sup do cua Trai Dat, nhung nguoi sot lai da phat dong cuoc Hyper Tek Exodus, phan tan AI, bo gen nang cao va cac nguyen mau khap hang nghin the gioi hat giong. Moi the gioi phat trien trong su co lap, hinh thanh cac loai moi, van hoa va cong nghe. O trung tam cua tat ca la Echo Core, mot di vat luong tu dang dap voi nhung bi an, ky uc va loi keu goi quyen nang. No thuc tinh ban, mot Overlord tai sinh, duoc duc nen boi di san va cong nghe.

packages.badge: CHIEN DICH GUY VAN - GIAI DOAN 1
packages.intro1: Chung toi vui mung thong bao ra mat chien dich gua vong duoc mong doi de bao dam tai tro cho viec hoan thien du an Hyper Tek dot pha dang co nhung buoc tien tich cuc! Day la co hoi de ban tham gia he sinh thai Hyper Tek voi tu cach la nguoi tham gia som bang cach lua chon tu bo suu tap do vat va goi hang doc quyen co so luong gioi han ma ban se khong muon bo lo. Hanh dong nhanh! Bang cach mua truc tiep tu chung toi tren nen tang nay, ban co the huong gia giam 10% bang cach cho phep chung toi chuyen khoan tiet kiem cho ban, tu viec tranh phi gua vong, duoc liet ke ben duoi!
packages.intro2: Vi tat ca cac vat pham ky thuat so Khong Can Thay the cua Hyper Tek duoc bao dam boi muc mua lai toi thieu, voi phan lon cung cung cap cac phan thuong trong game dang ke nang cao trai nghiem cua ban, de khuay dong moi thu, chung toi dang gioi thieu mot loat NFA (Non-Fungible Assets) phien ban gioi han voi muc thuong cao nhat se duoc cung cap. Day la co hoi hiem co vi nhung phan bo nay se khong bao gio lap lai! Khi cac san pham nay het hang hoac chung toi dat muc tieu tai tro, bat ky NFA phien ban gioi han chua duc nao con lai se bi xoa khoi trang web vinh vien!
packages.intro3: Chung toi da huy dong duoc hon 440.000 USD va dang tim kiem them 460.000 USD. Day la thoi diem cua ban de tham gia cung chung toi trong sang kien day thu vi nay; dung de no vuot qua! Mua ngay cac vat pham hoac goi hang co so luong gioi han cua ban va tro thanh mot phan cua He sinh thai Hyper Tek day phan khich.
packages.intro4: Hay nho dang ky vao danh sach mong muon va ket noi voi chung toi tren mang xa hoi de cap nhat thong tin! Hanh dong ngay, vi thoi gian la yeu to song con!
packages.discount: Tiet kiem 10% so voi gia niem yet
packages.commonNote:
Phan thuong, Phan thuong them va/hoac Giam gia khi quyen gop ngay bay gio.

LUU Y: Ngoai voucher duoc su dung cho cac tro choi truc tuyen hoac cac giao dich mua hang duoc chon, tat ca cac Phan thuong, Phan thuong them va/hoac Giam gia khac khong the duoc ket hop hoac su dung ket hop voi bat ky chuong trinh khuyen mai nao khac.

Tat ca cac goi quyen gop se bao gom ten duoc ghi trong phan ket phim cua qua trinh phat trien tro choi.
packages.specialCondition: Khi phat trien va hoan thien thanh cong tro choi/cac tro choi, moi nguoi quyen gop se nhan duoc gia tri toi thieu lon hon khoan dau tu ban dau cua ho trong cac phan thuong hoac goi de su dung trong tro choi/cac tro choi, va bat ky phan thuong them hoac phan thuong nao duoc hua khi quyen gop se duoc trao khi tro choi/cac tro choi duoc phat hanh.
